title: Pairs trade, two standard deviations
author: arhancanli
rationale: Bets that two closely related prices drift back together after moving apart. It holds one against the other, so it depends on their relationship rather than on the market's direction.
risks: A gap can keep growing, or mark a lasting change such as a takeover or a failing business. Short positions carry borrowing costs and can be recalled. Picking the pair after seeing the data flatters any test.
references: Gatev, Goetzmann and Rouwenhorst (2006), Pairs Trading: Performance of a Relative-Value Arbitrage Rule, Review of Financial Studies
